title: Partial-sum bar augmentation is a homotopy isomorphism
statement: Let A be a preadditive category with a zero object, countable coproducts, and coproducts in a universe u. For E:Nat→CochainComplex(A,Int) and r∈Nat, index the partial sums through n+r by the natural-number preorder lifted to u. The canonical total bar augmentation to the full coproduct of E [def-sc-partial-sum-bar-extra-degeneracy] is invertible in the homotopy category.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: Use the constructed extra degeneracy and Mathlib ExtraDegeneracy.homotopyEquiv to contract the alternating face-map complex to its single column. Totalize its explicit homotopy equivalence using horizontalHomotopy. Compose with the single-column collapse isomorphism. The resulting hom map is definitionally the canonical total augmentation, hence its quotient map is an isomorphism.

theorem augmentation_isIsoHomotopy (E : ℕ → CochainComplex A ℤ) (r : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (totalAugmentation (diagram.{u} E r) (cocone E r)))
